description: Land Aquisition - Halpane, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District.
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition/servitude right over a particular land parcel (Lot No. 01, block No. 01 in Halpane village) for public purpose. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, claimant information, and compensation procedures, which squarely fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters.
